clue.text: Shrub grew on pitch

indicators.note: in an across answer, one thing placed on another comes after it, so the word for grew goes second

parts.note: to pitch, as a ship does, is to rock
past tense of rise, to grow upwards

explanation.surface: A gardener notes a bush that sprang up on a sports field.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue 'grew on pitch' puts the word for grew after the word for pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: The rockrose is a low flowering shrub of the Cistus family.

clue.text: Best ever album chart entry

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the best performance yet achieved
second meaning: a disc that makes the music charts

explanation.surface: A music fan hails the greatest LP ever to enter the charts.
explanation.definitionFit: A record is both an unbeaten achievement and a vinyl disc of music that can climb the charts.

clue.text: Affectionate mate's after cold stout

parts.note: C is the standard abbreviation for cold, as on a tap
an affectionate, informal word for a husband

explanation.surface: A spouse fondly follows a pint of cold stout.
explanation.walkthrough: ''s after' means the mate's word comes after the word for cold. Stout looks like the beer but is the adjective plump.
explanation.definitionFit: Stout and chubby are both mild synonyms for plump or rather fat.

clue.text: Primer damaged centre of grandma's carpet

indicators.note: damaged things are knocked out of shape, so the letters of primer are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

indicators.note: asks for only the middle letters of the following word, dropping its ends

parts.note: the three central letters of grandma

explanation.surface: Undercoat paint has spoiled the middle of Granny's rug.
explanation.walkthrough: Carpet looks like a floor covering but is the verb, as in being carpeted by the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: To carpet someone is British slang for to scold or reprimand them formally.

clue.text: Switzerland entered into expensive contract for event

parts.note: a steep price is a high one

indicators.note: something that has entered is now inside, so Switzerland's code sits within the contract word

parts.note: a rental agreement
CH is Switzerland's international code (Confoederatio Helvetica)

explanation.surface: The Swiss sign a costly deal to stage some big occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: The steeplechase is an athletics or horse-racing event over jumps and obstacles.

clue.text: Quick to help the erring player

definitions.meaning: second meaning: to feed an actor a forgotten line

explanation.walkthrough: The player is a stage actor who has dried, not a sportsman who has fouled.
explanation.definitionFit: Prompt means punctual or swift, and in theatre it means to whisper a missed line to an actor.

clue.text: Make contact with heads of royal estate about crown hire

indicators.note: heads are the tops of things, so only the opening letter of each following word is kept

parts.note: the opening letters of these five words

explanation.surface: Someone phones the royal estate office about renting a crown.
explanation.definitionFit: To reach someone is to get in touch with them, for example by telephone.

clue.text: Being most experienced, marks a written exam about old city

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the exam word wraps around the city

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for the old German currency, marks
taken as written
an examination
Ur is the ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: A veteran teacher grades a paper on an ancient city.
explanation.definitionFit: Maturest is the superlative of mature, describing whoever is the most grown-up or seasoned.

clue.text: A game partnership invested in some land to do a deal

indicators.note: money invested in something is put inside it, so these letters go into the land word

parts.note: a tract is an area of land
taken as written
North-South, a partnership at the bridge table

explanation.surface: Business partners put money into some property to strike a deal.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge the four players sit as North, South, East and West, and North-South are partners.
explanation.definitionFit: To transact is to carry out a piece of business, as in completing a deal.

clue.text: Conservative politician breaking laws breaks down

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for Conservative

indicators.note: something breaking into a thing gets inside it, so the politician enters the laws

parts.note: regulations
Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A Tory MP flouting the rules finally collapses in tears.
explanation.definitionFit: To crumple is to collapse or give way, emotionally or physically.

clue.text: Mother carries batty aunt's old gown

indicators.note: to carry something is to hold it, so the mother word holds the rest

parts.note: an informal word for mother

indicators.note: batty means crazy, so the letters of the relative's word are scrambled

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Mum hauls her eccentric aunt's antique dress about.
explanation.definitionFit: A mantua was a loose woman's gown worn in the late 17th and 18th centuries.

clue.text: The order of chimps?

parts.note: surface reading: the zoological order or social hierarchy of apes
setter's reading: the letters C, H, I, M, P, S of the word itself run in a particular sequence

explanation.walkthrough: Order suggests the primate classification; in fact the six letters of chimps already stand in the sequence of the ABC.
explanation.definitionFit: The letters of chimps follow one another as they do in the ABC, which is the sequence the answer names.

clue.text: Sacks, say, for endless waffle

indicators.note: without an end, so the last letter of the waffle word is dropped

parts.note: to rabbit on is British slang for to talk at length

explanation.surface: Bags are given in exchange for idle chatter.
explanation.walkthrough: Sacks is not bags but Jonathan Sacks, former Chief Rabbi of the UK; the 'say' signals an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Lord Sacks was a famous example of a Jewish religious teacher and leader.

clue.text: Some fish and leafy vegetable served in beer

indicators.note: food served in a dish sits inside it, so the vegetable goes within the beer

parts.note: Pils is a pale lager, short for Pilsner
chard is a leafy green vegetable

explanation.surface: A pub menu offers fish with greens cooked in beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilchards are small oily sea fish of the herring family, the plural fitting 'some fish'.

clue.text: Players might brave a hostile reception

parts.note: setter's reading: orchestral musicians look towards their scores
surface reading: stand up to criticism or punishment

explanation.walkthrough: Players suggests sportsmen facing a jeering crowd, but here they are musicians who literally look at their sheet music.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to accept unpleasant consequences of one's actions bravely.

clue.text: Word meaning very little — it's without cryptic clue

parts.note: minus means lacking or without

indicators.note: cryptic means puzzling or obscure, so the letters of the following word are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A self-referential note that a tiny word comes with no hint attached.
explanation.walkthrough: The word is often misspelt MINISCULE; the wordplay's MINUS fixes the U.
explanation.definitionFit: Minuscule describes something extremely small, the same sense as very little.

clue.text: Lavish glutton entertains staff on a lake

indicators.note: a host who entertains has guests within the house, so the glutton word holds the staff word

parts.note: a greedy eater
a stick or pole
taken as written
L is the abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A greedy host throws a lavish party for workers by the lakeside.
explanation.definitionFit: Prodigal means wastefully extravagant, as with the spendthrift son of the parable.

clue.text: Reject blue act appearing first

indicators.note: tells you the act word leads, coming before the word for blue even though it is printed after it

parts.note: a turn is a performer's act on stage
feeling blue is feeling down

explanation.surface: A theatre turns away a smutty performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'appearing first' tells you to put the act word before the blue word. Blue looks like rude, as in a blue act, but means sad.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn down an offer is to reject or decline it.

clue.text: Out of one's sight, and mind?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: gone past a curve in the road and out of view

definitions.note: read as 'out of one's mind', sharing the opening words of the first definition
definitions.meaning: second meaning: out of one's mind, that is, mad

explanation.surface: A twist on the saying that what is out of sight is out of mind.
explanation.walkthrough: The words 'out of one's' serve both definitions: out of one's sight, and out of one's mind.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally means beyond a curve in the road and colloquially means crazy.

clue.text: About to drop stick

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for circa, Latin for about
to drop someone off is to leave them

explanation.surface: Someone is on the point of letting fall a walking stick.
explanation.walkthrough: Stick looks like a noun but is the verb, as in to cleave to someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleave has the archaic sense of adhere or cling, as well as the opposite sense of split.

clue.text: Vegetable placed around firm Spanish bread, once

indicators.note: something placed around another surrounds it, so the vegetable encloses the firm word

parts.note: a pea is a vegetable
set means firm or solid, as jelly is

explanation.surface: A recipe wraps something green around a crusty Spanish loaf.
explanation.walkthrough: Bread is slang for money, not a loaf.
explanation.definitionFit: The peseta was Spain's currency until the euro replaced it, and bread is slang for money.

clue.text: Dessert inn served, short of small plates etc

indicators.note: served suggests dished up in a fresh arrangement, so the letters are rearranged
short of means lacking, so one letter is taken away from the fodder

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
S is the abbreviation for small; this letter is the one removed

explanation.surface: A pub brings out pudding, missing some small crockery and cutlery.
explanation.walkthrough: Small gives S, the abbreviation, and one S comes out of the ten letters before they are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A dinner set is a matching collection of plates, dishes and similar tableware.

clue.text: "More rhubarb", might one say?

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a background actor, who mutters rhubarb to simulate crowd chatter

explanation.walkthrough: Film and stage crowd players traditionally murmur 'rhubarb, rhubarb' to make background noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Extra means additional, and an extra is a non-speaking actor in a crowd scene.

clue.text: Balm left in store

indicators.note: in places the left abbreviation inside the word for store

parts.note: to save is to store up
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A tube of ointment has been left on the shop shelf.
explanation.definitionFit: A salve is a soothing ointment, the same thing as a balm.

clue.text: Try to contain one excessive painter

indicators.note: to contain is to hold inside, so the try word holds the other pieces

parts.note: to have a go is to have a try
the Roman numeral for one
OTT is short for over the top

explanation.surface: An instruction to restrain a painter who overdoes things.
explanation.definitionFit: Giotto di Bondone was a celebrated early Renaissance Italian painter.

clue.text: Meticulous account by clergyman

parts.note: AC is the abbreviation for account
a curate is an assistant parish priest

explanation.surface: A careful financial record kept by the vicar's assistant.
explanation.definitionFit: Accurate work is precise and correct, as meticulous work is careful about detail.

clue.text: Secure gold carriage

parts.note: to land a deal or a fish is to secure it
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: Someone acquires a golden coach.
explanation.definitionFit: A landau is a four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with a folding hood.

clue.text: Touring east a devotee acquires a 23?

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the devotee phrase travels around the compass point

parts.note: a lover is a devotee or fan
E is the abbreviation for east
taken as written

explanation.surface: A fan travelling in the east picks up some ointment.
explanation.walkthrough: The '23' points to the answer at 23-across, SALVE, so the definition is a balm; the question mark flags this as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloe vera gel is a familiar soothing plant-based salve for burns and skin.
